briefing.headline: Harbour lead 1-0 at the break with 78.2% of the final-third passing

working.text: Harbour hold 55.2% of possession and more control (control index 55.2).
They have completed 34 entries into the final third, with 70.6% of those down the left flank.
Harbour press intensely and win the ball very high (PPDA 3.1 and turnover height 54.8 m), producing 19 high regains and 0.75 xG.

not_working.text: Their pass completion is 74%, only marginally higher than Kestrel, despite heavy attacking bias.

predictions.claim: Harbour will try to reduce Kestrel's right-channel entries by at least 30%.
Harbour's pressing intensity will decline, increasing their PPDA by at least 20%.
Harbour will increase their final-third entries by at least 20%.

working.text: Kestrel concentrate the majority of their entries down the right (58.3% of entries).
They have kept their pass completion broadly similar to Harbour (71.9% vs 74%).

not_working.text: Kestrel's press has been light (PPDA 11.2) and they have only 3 high regains and a turnover height of 28.8 m.
They are well behind on chance creation and expected goals (0.04 xG vs Harbour's 0.75).

predictions.claim: Kestrel will try to reduce Harbour's left-channel entries by at least 30%.
Kestrel will drop a midfielder to reduce Harbour's high regains by at least 30%.
Kestrel will increase their possession by at least 10%.
